name: CSC263H1 — Deductive Derivation (Union-Find with Path Compression)
description: Union-Find tracks disjoint sets. Three operations: Makeset(x), Find(x) (returns set representative), Union(x,y) (merges sets). With union by rank + pa

steps.template_en: Union-Find tracks disjoint sets. Three operations: Makeset(x), Find(x) (returns set representative), Union(x,y) (merges sets). With union by rank + path compression, m operations on n elements run in O(m·α(n)) — essentially constant!
steps.template_zh: Union-Find跟踪不相交集合。三个操作：Makeset(x)、Find(x)（返回集合代表）、Union(x,y)（合并集合）。使用按秩合并+路径压缩，n个元素上的m次操作为O(m·α(n))——几乎常数！

steps.template_en: Makeset(x): parent[x] = x; rank[x] = 0. Find(x): if parent[x]==x: return x; else: parent[x] = find(parent[x]); return parent[x]. Path compression: during find, point ALL traversed nodes directly to the root.
steps.template_zh: Makeset(x): parent[x]=x; rank[x]=0。Find(x): if parent[x]==x: return x; else: parent[x]=find(parent[x]); return parent[x]。路径压缩：在find期间，将所有经过的节点直接指向根。

steps.template_en: Union(x,y): rx=find(x), ry=find(y). If rx==ry: return. If rank[rx]<rank[ry]: parent[rx]=ry. If rank[rx]>rank[ry]: parent[ry]=rx. If equal: parent[ry]=rx; rank[rx]++. Union by rank: always attach smaller tree under larger tree — keeps height O(log n) without compression.
steps.template_zh: Union(x,y): rx=find(x), ry=find(y)。若rx==ry: return。若rank[rx]<rank[ry]: parent[rx]=ry。若rank[rx]>rank[ry]: parent[ry]=rx。若相等: parent[ry]=rx; rank[rx]++。按秩合并：始终将小树附在大树下——无压缩时高度O(log n)。

steps.template_en: Without compression: find is O(log n). With compression: subsequent finds become O(1). The total work for m finds is O(m·α(n)) where α is the inverse Ackermann function — grows so slowly that α(n) ≤ 4 for n up to 2^65536.
steps.template_zh: 无压缩：find是O(log n)。有压缩：后续find变为O(1)。m次find的总工作量为O(m·α(n))，其中α是反Ackermann函数——增长如此之慢，对n≤2^65536有α(n)≤4。

steps.template_en: Union-Find with both optimizations = '(near) constant time' per operation. The inverse Ackermann bound is the SLOWEST-growing function that appears in algorithm analysis. This makes Union-Find one of the most elegant data structures.
steps.template_zh: Union-Find加上两种优化=每次操作'(近)常数时间'。反Ackermann界是算法分析中出现的最慢增长函数。这使Union-Find成为最优雅的数据结构之一。

steps.template_en: Path compression is SELF-ADJUSTING — each find pays a little extra to make future finds cheaper. This 'pay now, benefit later' pattern appears in splay trees (self-adjusting BSTs) and other amortized data structures. The key insight: tall trees get flattened.
steps.template_zh: 路径压缩是自调整的——每次find多花一点成本使后续find更便宜。这种'现在付出，以后受益'模式出现在伸展树（自调整BST）和其他分摊数据结构中。关键洞见：高树被压平。
